unsupported.reason: Real production is scaled by era.resourceMultiplier; GDL regenPerMinute is static, so later eras are modelled with the same rates.
A fixed Lv2 reference build is assumed; building cost curves (buildingCost.ts) are not modelled.
Storage buildings and capacity upgrades (capacity.ts) are collapsed into fixed resource maxima.
Era 3+ breakthrough is a 50% dice roll (failure drops levels); modelled deterministically as a foundation_pill >= 2 requirement.
Simulation is continuous play time; lifespan exhaustion and daoHeart inheritance are out of scope.
The 5% x3 / 10% x2 craft multipliers in craft.ts are not modelled.

unsupported.feature: manual gathering, sect tasks, market, encounters, beast buffs
unsupported.reason: Player-policy layer not modelled in v0.1.
